blocks.text: In this lesson you learn to meet someone for the first time in English: say hello, say your name, and answer when someone says hello to you.
Anna and Pete meet for the first time. What do they say?

blocks.title: Anna and Pete meet for the first time
blocks.transcript:
Pete: Hi! Are you Anna?
Anna: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?
Pete: I am Pete.
Anna: Nice to meet you.
Anna: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
Pete: I'm Pete.

blocks.text: Listen again and read the important parts below — the parts you use when you meet someone.

— Hi! I'm Anna.
— I'm Pete. Nice to meet you.
blocks.translation:
— Chào! Tôi là Anna.
— Tôi là Pete. Rất vui được gặp bạn.
— Tôi cũng rất vui được gặp bạn.

blocks.text: “I'm” means “I am”. “I'm Anna” is how you say your name. “Nice to meet you” is what people say when they meet someone for the first time.

blocks.prompt: Anna says “Nice to meet you.” What is a good answer?

blocks.text: Say it out loud. Use your own name — not Anna or Pete.

— Hi, I'm ______.
— Nice to meet you.
— Nice to meet you too.
blocks.translation:
— Chào, tôi là ______.
— Rất vui được gặp bạn.
— Tôi cũng rất vui được gặp bạn.
